youtube_full.title: I Will Love Them Freely | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Hosea 14:4–7
youtube_full.description:
I Will Love Them Freely: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Hosea 14:4–7.

Hosea’s people kept wandering away and stopped following Heavenly Father. But He made them a kind promise.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Willow the Warm.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: I Will Love Them Freely
1:07 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Willow the Warm
1:43 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:53 Question time
3:10 Sweet dreams
3:28 More stories, the app and the paperback
